3. National Council.Consists of (i) Official Side up to 25 members nominated by Government which will include Cabinet Secretary, Secretaries of Ministries of Home Affairs, Labour, Communications, Defence, Finance \(Department of Expenditure and Revenue) and Railways, and (ii) Staff Side up to 60 members nominated by the recognized Unions/ Associations. Cabinet Secretary will be the Chairman and Staff Side to have a leader. Each side will have its own Secretary/Secretaries.
